name: manual_7abca1
claim: Make an agent's compliance checkable: give literal numbered instructions with the expected output of each step, a forbidden-actions list and a rule that no claim of pushed or verified is valid without the pasted proving command output, then verify every claim yourself with git (merge-base --is-ancestor, branch -r --contains, ls-remote, cat-file).

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: one agent reported work as pushed when it was not and quoted commit ids that do not exist; it then followed literal proof-bearing instructions exactly and corrected itself.
